timeline.2020.title: The origin
timeline.2020.desc: Creativa Carrada is born as a very small studio, driven by curiosity and necessity. We created simple websites using accessible tools, learning from scratch. The beginning of a mentality that remains valid: doing the best with what you have.
timeline.2021.title: First important steps
timeline.2021.desc: We collaborated with UNAM in creating digital resources. We developed our first websites for a highly relevant institution, marking a before and after in our level of responsibility and professional vision.
timeline.2022.title: Expansion and strategy
timeline.2022.desc: We worked with Citibanamex, Anáhuac University and the National Action Party. Our role evolved: we were not just building websites, but participating in marketing strategies and digital decisions. The project became impact.
timeline.2023.title: New identity, new horizons
timeline.2023.desc: We renamed ourselves Zoi Marketing. We worked with Sanborns, CENAPyME and the Government of Mexico. We began advising influencers on branding, strategy and digital presence. Our network grew, as did our creative ambition.
timeline.2024.title: Recognition and professionalization
timeline.2024.desc: We were recognized in the "Law of Attraction" podcast. We strengthened relationships and expanded our field into software. We made a key decision: professionalize ourselves to the maximum. Thus Chiikö was born.
timeline.2025.title: Chiikö is officially created
timeline.2025.desc: We founded Chiikö with a clear vision: create digital crafts. Websites built with intention, criteria and depth. The beginning of a new era where technology meets the art of creating meaningful digital experiences.
timeline.2026.title: Chiikö today
timeline.2026.desc: We cultivate alliances with companies like Pinterest Mexico and Google Mexico. We collaborate with OpenAI, Red Hat and key players in the tech ecosystem. Our vision: websites as digital crafts, built with intention, criteria and depth.
values.whatWeBelieve.p1: At Chiikö we believe that a website is not just another file or a simple digital channel. It's a strategic object, a living extension of a brand and a key piece in how a company presents itself, is perceived and grows.
values.whatWeBelieve.p2: We don't design to follow fleeting trends. We design to build criteria, clarity and coherence over the long term.
values.whatWeBelieve.p3: Every decision —from architecture to the smallest visual detail— has a reason.
values.howWeWork.intro: We work with a clear, collaborative and deeply intentional process.
values.howWeWork.step1.desc: the brand, the business, its limits and its real objectives.
values.howWeWork.step2: Then we design the structure before the form.
values.howWeWork.step2.desc: We think about content, hierarchy, flows and experience.
values.howWeWork.step3: Finally, we develop with technical precision,
values.howWeWork.step3.desc: taking care of performance, accessibility and scalability.
values.howWeWork.conclusion: We don't believe in inflated processes or unnecessary deliverables. We believe in doing what's right, but doing it well.
values.digitalCrafts.intro: At Chiikö we call our work digital craftsmanship.
values.digitalCrafts.reason3: Because every site is built to measure, with time, criteria and attention to detail.
values.digitalCrafts.comparison: Just as craftsmanship has intention behind every cut and every material, our sites have intention behind every design and development decision.
values.mexicanOrigin: We are proud of our Mexican origin and culture.
values.mexicanOrigin.desc: The term "digital craftsmanship" is born precisely from that: from the Mexican tradition of making things by hand, with care, with criteria and with soul. Of building objects that endure because they carry time, intention and mastery behind them.
values.mexicanOrigin.conclusion: That ancestral philosophy of our country is what we bring to the digital world.
values.whatWeDo: What we do (and what we don't)?
values.whatWeDo.p1: We design and develop strategic websites for brands that value design, clarity and real impact.
values.whatWeDo.p2: We work with companies, studios, institutions and projects that understand their digital presence is an investment, not an expense.
values.notForEveryone: We're not for everyone. And that's okay.
values.notForEveryone.p1: If you're looking for speed without criteria or volume without depth, we're probably not the right studio.
values.notForEveryone.p2: If you want to build something solid, well-thought-out and lasting, yes.
values.chiikotoday.p1: Chiikö is a creative and technological studio in constant evolution. We learn from the industry, collaborate with major players in the digital ecosystem and stay close to what's new, without losing our criteria.
values.chiikotoday.p2: We continue to grow with one clear idea: to elevate the way websites are conceived and built.
